evidence.title: Agentic job-hunting platform Jack & Jill raises $40 million led by Air Street Capital

name: Exclusive: Agentic job platform Jack & Jill raises $40M
summary: Axios Pro deal report on Jack & Jill, a London agentic job-finding platform, raising a $40 million Series A led by Air Street Capital.
description: Deals post by Chris Metinko dated Sep 14, 2026: Jack & Jill uses AI agents to pair the right job seeker with the right opening; CEO Matt Wilson tells Axios Pro the London company raised a $40 million Series A led by Air Street Capital.
